hints.title: Is a capacity feasible?
hints.body: Forget finding the minimum for a moment. Given a capacity, how would you check whether the packages fit in the allowed number of days?

hints.title: Feasibility is monotone
hints.body: If a capacity works, every larger capacity also works. The set of feasible capacities is a suffix of the possible range, which makes it searchable by binary search.

hints.title: Choose the bounds
hints.body: The capacity can never be smaller than the heaviest package, and never needs to exceed the total weight. For a candidate capacity, greedily fill each day until the next package would overflow, then start a new day.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
low = max(weights)
high = sum(weights)
while low < high:
    middle = low + (high - low) // 2
    if shipsNeeded(middle) <= days:
        high = middle
    else:
        low = middle + 1
return low

shipsNeeded(capacity):
    ships = 1
    load = 0
    for weight in weights:
        if load + weight > capacity:
            ships += 1
            load = weight
        else:
            load += weight
    return ships
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Handle a package heavier than the capacity if your bounds allow it, though the lower bound here prevents it.
